observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a red leather sofa with visible creases and wear on the backrest and armrests.
Photo 1 shows the full sofa from the front, placed on a patterned rug, with visible creases and wear on the seat and backrest.
The sofa has a glossy finish, typical of faux leather or vinyl leather.
No visible brand or model markings are present on the sofa in either photo.
The seller claims it is a '2 seater double seater leather sofa' and in 'good condition'.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a sofa with two seat cushions and two backrest sections, consistent with a 2-seater double seater design.
Photos show creases and wear, but no full inspection of all surfaces or structural integrity is possible remotely. The condition is subjective and not fully verifiable from the photos alone.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or structural issues not visible in photos, such as loose joints, broken springs, or internal frame damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the sofa being moved or a close-up of the underside and joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: The material is not genuine leather but faux leather, which may have a shorter lifespan and lower value.
risks.proof: A close-up of the material texture and a label or tag indicating material type.
risks.if_unproven: priced as faux leather, which is less valuable than genuine leather

risks.risk: The sofa may have stains, odors, or hidden tears not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A full 360-degree video or close-up photos of all surfaces, including under the cushions and armrests.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially stained or damaged

proof_requests: Close-up of the manufacturer's label or model number, usually inside the armrest or on the back.
A video showing the sofa being moved or a close-up of the underside and joints.
Close-up photos of the material texture and any labels or tags.
A full 360-degree view or close-up photos of all surfaces, including under the cushions and armrests.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
